title: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
issues_framed: Whether Section 66A of the Information Technology Act violates the fundamental right to free speech under Article 19(1)(a)?
Whether the statutory restrictions satisfy the test of clear and present danger or reasonable restrictions under Article 19(2)?
summary: Struck down Section 66A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 in its entirety for violating Article 19(1)(a). Held that liberty of thought and expression cannot be suppressed on vague assertions of causing annoyance or inconvenience.

title: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
issues_framed: Whether police officers must compulsorily record reasons before making an arrest under Section 41(1)(b) CrPC for offenses punishable up to seven years?
Whether mechanical remand orders without verification of Section 41A compliance are unlawful?
summary: Issued binding nationwide directives preventing routine and unnecessary arrests under Section 498A IPC and other offenses carrying punishment up to 7 years. Mandated notice of appearance under Section 41A CrPC prior to custodial detention.
